# netactuate_server_ips (Data Source)

Reads Server Ips visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_server_ips" "example" {
  mbpkgid = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mbpkgid` (Number) Server package ID whose IP addresses will be listed

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ipv4` (List of Object) List of IPv4 addresses for the server (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ipv4))
- `ipv6` (List of Object) List of IPv6 addresses for the server (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ipv6))

<a id="nestedatt--ipv4"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ipv4`

Read-Only:

- `broadcast` (String)
- `gateway` (String)
- `id` (Number)
- `ip` (String)
- `netmask` (String)
- `primary` (Number)
- `reverse` (String)
